verdict.rationale: KYB is a fair question for an identity-verification product, so the axis applies. Every evidence item describes verifying individuals: ID documents, phone, name, DOB, liveness, and watchlist/PEP screening via Monitor. Nothing shows business registry lookups, UBO identification, or KYB flows that chain into KYC on the owners.

support.subject: As an ops lead, I can verify businesses, not just people — registry lookups, UBO identification, and documented KYB flows that chain into KYC on the owners
